---
title: "S5 Adding hight into space data"
output: html_document
---



```{r}
# ---- Packages ----
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(here)
library(stringr)

# Tell here() where the project root is
here::i_am("scripts/S5 Adding hight into space data.Rmd")

# ---- Paths (relative to project root) ----
stations_path <- here("dataset", "row", "nmdb_stations_final.csv")
merged_path   <- here("dataset", "outcomes", "from_s2", "nmdb_merged_2000_2026.csv")

out_dir  <- here("dataset", "outcomes", "from_s5")
out_path <- file.path(out_dir, "nmdb_merged_2000_2026_with_alt.csv")
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# ---- Read stations (altitude table) ----
stations <- read_csv(stations_path, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  transmute(
    station = str_trim(as.character(station)),
    alt_m   = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(alt_m))
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(station), station != "") %>%
  distinct(station, .keep_all = TRUE)

alt_map <- setNames(stations$alt_m, stations$station)

# ---- Read merged (keep datetime as character to avoid format drift) ----
merged <- read_csv(
  merged_path,
  show_col_types = FALSE,
  col_types = cols(datetime = col_character())
)

# Basic sanity checks
stopifnot("datetime" %in% names(merged))

station_cols <- setdiff(names(merged), "datetime")
if (length(station_cols) == 0) stop("No station columns found in merged file.")

# ---- Build alt_m row (this row must be placed ABOVE the first datetime row) ----
# Create an empty one-row template with same columns/types as merged
alt_row <- merged[1, , drop = FALSE]

# Set everything to NA first (preserve column types as much as possible)
alt_row[1, ] <- NA

# Put label in datetime column
alt_row$datetime <- "alt_m"

# Fill each station column with its altitude
for (st in station_cols) {
  v <- unname(alt_map[st])  # numeric or NA

  # If merged column is character, store altitude as character; otherwise store numeric
  if (is.character(merged[[st]])) {
    alt_row[[st]] <- ifelse(is.na(v), NA_character_, as.character(v))
  } else {
    alt_row[[st]] <- as.numeric(v)
  }
}

# ---- Insert alt_row ABOVE the first datetime row ----
# Result order: alt_m row first, then all original rows
merged_with_alt <- bind_rows(alt_row, merged)

# ---- Write output ----
write_csv(merged_with_alt, out_path, na = "")

# ---- Diagnostics ----
cat("Saved to:", out_path, "\n")

missing_alt <- station_cols[is.na(unname(alt_map[station_cols]))]
if (length(missing_alt) > 0) {
  cat("Warning: missing alt_m for", length(missing_alt), "stations.\n")
  print(missing_alt)
} else {
  cat("All station columns matched to alt_m.\n")
}

# Optional: quick preview of the first 3 rows and first 10 columns
print(merged_with_alt[1:3, 1:min(10, ncol(merged_with_alt))])


```
